notes: use_live_national_avg=true fetches the EIA national average retail price (all sectors) live from the EIA API v2.
electricity_cost_per_kwh_usd is only used when use_live_national_avg=false; set to null to always prefer live data.
Set site_kw_override to a facility-specific kW load to compute exact one-place $/hour.
If site_kw_override is 0, the engine uses the latest live ISO demand from live_eia_<ISO>.csv.
